title: Eurowatch
desc: Get 24/7 emergency help for your employees across Europe, USA, Canada, Mexico, Australia and New Zealand using our international alarm receiving service.
content:
Protection in 40+ countries

Get 24/7 emergency help for your employees in major countries across Europe, North America and Australasia through our international alarm receiving service in partnership with Teletrac Navman.

We know that 75% of people who travel for business feel unsafe and that a third of them would avoid doing it altogether due to safety concerns.* Give your staff Eurowatch to protect them when working overseas.

*Talent Exodus & Rising Business Costs

Alarms are picked up by our global partners within 15 seconds.

It takes less than 3 minutes from an alarm being received by the Peoplesafe control centre to information being given to the control centre in the country of incident.

Using pinpoint GPS data, profile information and conversations with the employee, the local service provider will have a report telling them:

  • who the person is
  • where they are in the country
  • details of the incident
  • important information (e.g. medical conditions)

Service availability

Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Italy, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Republic of Ireland, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, United States of America

During an alarm, your staff will speak with our expertly trained UK-based Alarm Controllers to provide them with an English-speaking contact wherever they are.

The local control centre will liaise with their Peoplesafe counterparts who will provide updates directly to the employee and be in touch with relevant escalation contacts.

Eurowatch alarms, like any others, will only be ended once the employee has confirmed they are safe and happy for it to be closed down.
